title: PM Retrospective Report
description: The retrospective PM writes in /dev-overnight RETRO mode (agents/pm.md, Step 9), docs/dev/overnight/<session_id>/retro-report-cycle<N>.json; G2 checks it at PM's own stop. Its presence ends the cycle (hooks/lib/overnight.py cycle_index) and the next cycle's PLAN reads its unresolved_issues. is_final_cycle carries the dispatch's FINAL_CYCLE; the final cycle's report holds final_summary. task_id is the identity the obligation names. Every other field of the PM payload is allowed.
